name: sncf-mcp
author: krezzoid
description: Plan journeys and query stations, upcoming departures, and service disruptions through the official SNCF and Navitia open-data API.

installation.notes: The README provides complete build and stdio startup commands from source and an alternative Docker build-and-run sequence, including injection of the required API key.

configuration.notes: The required Go 1.26+ runtime, free SNCF API key acquisition, SNCF_API_KEY environment variable, container alternative, and key-handling behavior are explicitly documented.

tools.notes: The four tools are clearly described and two direct tool-call examples include concrete arguments and output, but no natural-language user prompt is supplied.

compatibility.notes: The README explicitly identifies stdio and supplies a complete Claude Desktop configuration with the executable path and required environment variable.

license.notes: The README declares MIT and links to complete MIT license terms applying to the server software.

limitations.notes: Ticket prices are unavailable because the open-data API has no fares and the server will not scrape them; the ADR explains the user impact and workaround. Coverage, timezone, and rate-limit behavior are also documented.
